question: Which of our strategic accounts are at risk because of late shipments, and what should the account teams do this week?

input.purpose: See which tier values exist for Salesforce accounts and how many are current.
input.sql: SELECT tier_c, _fivetran_active, is_deleted, COUNT(*) AS n FROM salesforce.account GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check shipment status values and sync freshness in the carrier database.
input.sql: SELECT status, _fivetran_deleted, COUNT(*) n, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, MAX(updated_at) max_upd FROM carrier_pg.shipment GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Look at shipment event types and sample rows to understand late/delivered signals.
input.sql: SELECT event_type, COUNT(*) n, MAX(event_at) max_at, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync FROM carrier_pg.shipment_event GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check Zendesk ticket statuses, types and tags to identify open shipping tickets.
input.sql: SELECT type, status, COUNT(*) n, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync FROM zendesk.ticket WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Check the SAP delivery header dates and carrier field freshness.
input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n, MAX(_fivetran_synced) last_sync, MIN(wadat) min_wadat, MAX(wadat) max_wadat, COUNT(DISTINCT zz_carrier_id) carriers FROM sap_s4.likp WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted

input.purpose: Test the join path shipment -> SAP delivery -> customer -> Salesforce account and sample dates.
input.sql: SELECT s.shipment_id, s.delivery_number, s.carrier_code, s.status, l.vbeln, l.kunnr, l.lfdat, l.wadat, l.wadat_ist, k.name_1, a.name, a.tier_c, a.sap_customer_number_c FROM carrier_pg.shipment s LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted LEFT JOIN sap_s4.kna_1 k ON k.kunnr = l.kunnr AND NOT k._fivetran_deleted LEFT JOIN salesforce.account a ON a.sap_customer_number_c = l.kunnr AND a._fivetran_active LIMIT 30

input.purpose: Measure how many shipments match a SAP delivery and an active Salesforce account.
input.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) total, COUNT(l.vbeln) matched_delivery, COUNT(a.id) matched_account, COUNT(DISTINCT s.shipment_id) distinct_ship FROM carrier_pg.shipment s LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln = s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted LEFT JOIN salesforce.account a ON a.sap_customer_number_c = l.kunnr AND a._fivetran_active WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted

input.purpose: Compare delivered event date with SAP requested delivery date (lfdat) by month to define lateness and choose a window.
input.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT s.shipment_id, s.status, l.kunnr, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date req, CAST(e.event_at AS DATE) delivered_on FROM carrier_pg.shipment s JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted LEFT JOIN carrier_pg.shipment_event e ON e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted) SELECT strftime(req,'%Y-%m') mth, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN status='delivered' AND delivered_on > req THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late, SUM(CASE WHEN status='cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) cancelled FROM d GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 30

input.purpose: Check whether delivered events fall on the same day or later than the planned goods issue, and how many shipments lack a delivered event.
input.sql: SELECT s.status, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(e.event_id) with_delivered_event, SUM(CASE WHEN e.event_at::date > try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) delivered_after_lfdat FROM carrier_pg.shipment s LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted LEFT JOIN carrier_pg.shipment_event e ON e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered' WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY ALL

input.purpose: See how Zendesk organizations link to Salesforce accounts and what external_id contains.
input.sql: SELECT o.id, o.name, o.external_id, a.id sf_id, a.name sf_name, a.sap_customer_number_c FROM zendesk.organization o LEFT JOIN salesforce.account a ON a.name = o.name AND a._fivetran_active WHERE NOT o._fivetran_deleted ORDER BY o.id LIMIT 60

input.purpose: Look at ticket tags to identify shipping or delivery related tickets.
input.sql: SELECT tag, COUNT(*) n FROM zendesk.ticket_tag WHERE NOT _fivetran_deleted GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 60

input.purpose: Look at renewal and open opportunities for Strategic accounts to find renewal close dates.
input.sql: SELECT o.type, o.stage_name, o.is_closed, o.is_won, COUNT(*) n, MIN(o.close_date) min_close, MAX(o.close_date) max_close FROM salesforce.opportunity o WHERE NOT o.is_deleted AND NOT o._fivetran_deleted GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY n DESC

input.purpose: Compute on-time rate and late deliveries for active Strategic accounts over the trailing 90 days by requested date.
input.sql:
WITH sh AS (
SELECT a.id acct_id, a.name, s.shipment_id, s.status, try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date req, CAST(e.event_at AS DATE) delivered_on
FROM carrier_pg.shipment s
JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.vbeln=s.delivery_number AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted
JOIN salesforce.account a ON a.sap_customer_number_c=l.kunnr AND a._fivetran_active AND a.tier_c='Strategic'
LEFT JOIN carrier_pg.shipment_event e ON e.shipment_id=s.shipment_id AND e.event_type='delivered'
WHERE NOT s._fivetran_deleted AND s.status='delivered'
AND try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-08' AND DATE '2026-11-06')
SELECT name, acct_id, COUNT(*) delivered, SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_on>req THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) late, ROUND(100.0*(1-SUM(CASE WHEN delivered_on>req THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)/COUNT(*)),1) on_time_pct FROM sh GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY late DESC, on_time_pct ASC

input.purpose: Check which Zendesk tags and statuses define open shipping-related tickets, and how tags overlap.
input.sql: SELECT t.tag, tk.status, COUNT(DISTINCT tk.id) n FROM zendesk.ticket tk JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag t ON t.ticket_id=tk.id AND NOT t._fivetran_deleted WHERE NOT tk._fivetran_deleted AND t.tag IN ('shipping','delivery','late_delivery','logistics') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

input.purpose: For each active Strategic account, count open shipping/delivery tickets and find the next open renewal close date.
input.sql:
WITH strat AS (SELECT id, name, sap_customer_number_c FROM salesforce.account WHERE _fivetran_active AND NOT is_deleted AND tier_c='Strategic'),
tk AS (SELECT o.external_id acct_id, COUNT(DISTINCT t.id) open_ship_tickets, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT tg.tag, ',') tags, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT t.subject, ' | ') subjects FROM zendesk.ticket t JOIN zendesk.organization o ON o.id=t.organization_id AND NOT o._fivetran_deleted JOIN zendesk.ticket_tag tg ON tg.ticket_id=t.id AND NOT tg._fivetran_deleted AND tg.tag IN ('shipping','delivery','late_delivery','logistics') WHERE NOT t._fivetran_deleted AND t.status IN ('new','open','pending','hold') GROUP BY 1),
ren AS (SELECT account_id, MIN(close_date) next_renewal, SUM(amount) renewal_amt FROM salesforce.opportunity WHERE NOT is_closed AND NOT is_deleted AND NOT _fivetran_deleted AND type='Renewal' GROUP BY 1)
SELECT s.name, s.id, s.sap_customer_number_c, COALESCE(tk.open_ship_tickets,0) open_ship_tickets, tk.tags, tk.subjects, ren.next_renewal, ren.renewal_amt FROM strat s LEFT JOIN tk ON tk.acct_id=s.id LEFT JOIN ren ON ren.account_id=s.id ORDER BY open_ship_tickets DESC, next_renewal

input.purpose: Identify the Strategic account with no shipments in the window and check shipment volume for the whole Strategic book.
input.sql: SELECT a.name, a.id, a.sap_customer_number_c, COUNT(s.shipment_id) ships_all_time, MAX(try_strptime(l.lfdat,'%Y%m%d')::date) last_req FROM salesforce.account a LEFT JOIN sap_s4.likp l ON l.kunnr=a.sap_customer_number_c AND NOT l._fivetran_deleted LEFT JOIN carrier_pg.shipment s ON s.delivery_number=l.vbeln AND NOT s._fivetran_deleted WHERE a._fivetran_active AND a.tier_c='Strategic' GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY ships_all_time

answer.answer_summary: Ten of our 25 measurable Strategic accounts were below 85% on-time delivery over the last 90 days, led by Tamwick Mining (61.5%, 10 late) and Tamford Food Processing (69.0%, 9 late). The highest-urgency items this week are Sevland Utilities (renewal 2026-12-06, $435K), plus Tamwick, Tamford and Galbury, which each have 2 to 3 open shipping tickets. Vornland Chemicals has a $1.12M renewal closing 2026-11-15 and should be checked before signature.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: Lowest on-time rate in the Strategic book (10 of 26 deliveries late). Three open shipping tickets, including bearing delays on line 1227 and a late order. Largest exposure: $827K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead and Operations to call the customer this week with a recovery plan for the late orders. Assign an owner to close the three open tickets. Review carrier performance on this account's lanes.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 9 of 29 deliveries late. Open tickets cover a late order and an order not yet received. $654K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Operations to confirm the status of the two open orders and give the customer a firm delivery date. Account lead to schedule an operations review before the renewal cycle starts.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 8 of 31 deliveries late and one open late-order ticket. The renewal closes in about 30 days ($435K), so the risk to the deal is near-term.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead to escalate now: confirm the open ticket is resolved and bring the on-time recovery plan into the renewal conversation before 2026-12-06.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 23 deliveries late. Three open tickets: an order not received, a missing delivery and a late order. $584K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Operations to trace the three open orders this week and give the account team a status update to share with the customer.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 26 deliveries late, plus one open late-order ticket. $223K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead to contact the customer about the open late order and agree a delivery-performance check-in. Note a duplicate Salesforce record (see caveats).

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 7 of 30 deliveries late. Open tickets say a shipment was 'delayed again' and an order was shipped. $179K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Operations to review the repeat-delay shipment with the carrier and confirm the tracking status. Account lead to send the customer a written update.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 6 of 27 deliveries late. One open ticket: tracking not updating for a shipment. $217K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Operations to fix the tracking gap and confirm the shipment's location to the customer. Account lead to review delivery performance at the next check-in.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 4 of 19 deliveries late, with no open shipping tickets. Renewal closes 2026-12-21 ($302K), so the risk is commercial rather than an open service issue.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead to bring a delivery-performance summary into the renewal discussion before 2026-12-21.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 5 of 27 deliveries late, with no open tickets. $744K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Account lead to review the five late deliveries with the customer and confirm the root cause is resolved before the renewal discussion.

at_risk_accounts.drivers: 3 of 19 deliveries late, but three open shipping tickets, including a delay on bearings for line 8407 and an order that arrived late. $645K renewal.
at_risk_accounts.next_step: Operations to clear the three open tickets this week, starting with the bearing delay on line 8407. Account lead to confirm to the customer when they are closed.

metrics_used.name: On-time delivery rate (Strategic accounts, trailing 90 days)
metrics_used.definition: Share of delivered shipments whose 'delivered' event date is on or before the SAP requested delivery date (likp.lfdat), for shipments with a requested date from 2026-08-08 to 2026-11-06. Late = delivered after lfdat.

metrics_used.name: Late deliveries
metrics_used.definition: Count of delivered shipments in the window where the delivered event date is after lfdat.

metrics_used.name: Open shipping tickets
metrics_used.definition: Zendesk tickets with status new, open, pending or hold, tagged shipping, delivery, late_delivery or logistics, linked to the account via zendesk.organization.external_id = salesforce.account.id.

metrics_used.name: Next renewal close date and amount
metrics_used.definition: Earliest open Renewal opportunity (not closed, not deleted) for the account in salesforce.opportunity.

lineage: carrier_pg.shipment + carrier_pg.shipment_event -> sap_s4.likp (delivery_number = vbeln, kunnr) -> salesforce.account (sap_customer_number_c = kunnr, active, tier Strategic) -> on_time_delivery_rate
zendesk.ticket + zendesk.ticket_tag + zendesk.organization (external_id = account id) -> open_shipping_tickets
assumptions: 'Strategic accounts' means salesforce.account rows with tier_c = 'Strategic', active (_fivetran_active = true) and not deleted: 26 accounts.
'Late' means the delivered event date is after the SAP requested delivery date (lfdat). The SAP planned goods-issue date was not used.
The window is the trailing 90 days by requested delivery date (2026-08-08 to 2026-11-06). The result is sensitive to this choice.
At-risk threshold: on-time rate below 85% in the window. Renewal dates and open tickets were used as urgency context, not as entry criteria.
Open shipping tickets: status new, open, pending or hold, with a shipping-related tag (shipping, delivery, late_delivery, logistics). The late_delivery tag had no open tickets for these accounts.
Shipments link to accounts through SAP customer number (kunnr), and Zendesk tickets link through the Salesforce account ID.
Renewal close date is the earliest open Renewal opportunity for each account.
caveats: Tool budget ran out before I could verify every ticket subject or check the Strategic accounts with the fewest open tickets, so ticket counts are approximate.

Halbrook Fluid Systems GmbH (Salesforce id 001KHodrD6UyqZnaQR) is an active Strategic record with no SAP customer number and 2 open shipping tickets. It looks like a duplicate of Halbrook Fluid Systems. Its shipments cannot be measured, so its on-time rate is unknown. Fix the record before the account teams act on it.
Vornland Chemicals SA has 92.3% on-time (2 late) and a $1.12M renewal closing 2026-11-15, nine days from the as-of date. It is not on the at-risk list, but it needs a check before signature.

Tamdale Food Processing (2 open tickets, $983K renewal 2026-12-19) and Harvale Food Processing (1 open tracking ticket, $1.14M renewal 2026-12-20) are on-time above 95%. They are watch items because of the renewal size and open tracking issues.

Zendesk, carrier and SAP sync timestamps (2026-11-09 to 2026-11-11) are after the 2026-11-06 as-of date. This may indicate a timezone or clock issue. Ticket statuses may have changed since the last sync.
Only 25 of 26 Strategic accounts could be measured for on-time rate (the missing one is the duplicate Halbrook record above).
The 'Late' count uses the delivered event date, which is stored in UTC. Shipments delivered near midnight could shift by a day.

explanation.detail: Named 1 account(s) that are not at risk: Vornridge Water Works Ltd; missed 0 that are.
